status.noTenant: The namespace is not bound to a tenant

tenants.search: Search tenants by name, slug, owner…
tenants.limitsAboutBody: These values replace the platform limits for this tenant only. Reset brings back the platform ones.
tenants.limitsReset: Limits of {{name}} reset to platform defaults
tenants.assignOwnerHint: {{name}} — current owner: {{owner}}. The previous owner becomes an admin; the new one must not own another tenant.
tenants.orphanedBody: The owner's account was deleted. Assign a new owner and the tenant works again.
tenants.suspendWarnBody: Runs are blocked, tokens stop working and schedules pause.
tenants.suspendReasonHint: The owner sees this reason, and it goes into the audit log.
tenants.deleteBody: Every run, result, library record, provider, token and webhook is deleted, and the tenant's space in Graphene is retired. This can't be undone.
tenants.deleteBlocked: Runs are going right now, and the server refuses until they finish or get cancelled.

users.search: Search users by name or e-mail…
users.fromConfig: Granted by the server config (STROPPY_ADMIN_EMAILS); you can’t change it here.
users.self: You cannot change your own admin flag.
users.revoked: {{name}} is no longer a platform admin

runs.hint: The queue across all tenants. Without a status filter only active runs show (pending, running, cancelling).
runs.cancelBody: The run in {{tenant}} stops and its stand is removed. The author gets an email, and the action goes into the audit log.
runs.notLive: The run is not live. Nothing to cancel
runs.tenantUnknown: The run's tenant was not found

settings.tenantCreationHint: Who can create tenants. Each account still owns at most one.
settings.publicRatingHint: Turns on the public rating page and the tenants' public name field.
settings.examplesHint: Shows the built-in examples people can clone or run right away.
settings.retentionMaxHint: No tenant's retention can go above this.
settings.defaultLimitsHint: They apply to every tenant without custom limits, and changes take effect right away.
settings.catalogHint: Static source of /catalog/stroppy: available stroppy versions, images and scripts. Validated against the system.stroppy_catalog schema when present.
